text: Google Sign-In is wired into the existing /auth/mobile route by branching on idToken vs email/password, preserving the same response shape.
The sign-in screen includes a 'Continue with Google' button.
The logo layout bug is fixed: the logo no longer renders at full width.
The submit button is validated in real time based on form field state.
Chat unread badge is fixed by moving the realtime listener into AppShell.
iOS Google Sign-In configuration is updated via GoogleService-Info.plist and Info.plist.
